name: Aras / Aras-2 tactical vehicle
armament: Pintle 12.7 mm DShK or 7.62 mm PKM in the cargo bed
Can carry a 106 mm recoilless rifle, Toophan ATGM launcher or the AD-08 Majid short-range air-defence launcher
protection: Unarmoured or lightly armoured cab (dimensions and weight are approximate: few published figures). Game: soft-skin; small arms disable crew and tyres; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Boxy Iranian 4x4 utility truck with a short bonnet, flat windscreen and two-door or four-door cab, open cargo bed with roll bar
Large off-road tyres on 2 axles, high ground clearance, front bull bar and winch
Weapon mount on a pedestal in the bed; Majid SAM version carries a 4-round launcher box on a turntable
Usually Artesh sand/khaki paint with black number plates and a small Iranian flag; IRGC versions in olive
variants: Aras-2 with AD-08 Majid SHORAD launcher
